decision_basis: Constructed discipline control; not proof Ackman actually rejected Alibaba or categorically rejects Chinese investments.

drivers.driver: Regulatory changes and offshore/VIE enforceability can dominate the value reaching ADS holders; ordinary shareholder activism cannot control them.

A profitable commerce engine is not sufficient if future shareholder rights, merchant rules and distributable cash cannot be forecast narrowly enough. No independently bounded special-situation payoff established.

outcome_note: No later earnings, policy changes or share returns used. The rule is controllable/predictable shareholder economics, not a blanket geographic ban. Strong cash and network advantages are real counterevidence; a specially justified bounded option could be different.
